d: Shivangi ki haldi men dikha royal luk, pestal pink lahange par goldan embroyadri ne khincha dhyan.. bihar ke bahubli neta anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi in dinon khub charcha men hai. shadi ki rasmon ke bich ab unki haldi seremni ke vidiyo bhi samne aane lage hain. in vidiyo men shivangi ka behad khubsurat aur royal andaj dekhne ko mil raha hai. khas taur par unke aautphit ne logon ka dhyan khincha hai. pestal pink aur goldan kalar ke kombineshan vale is lahange men shivangi kisi rajkumari se kam nahin lag rahi hain.
